summary_md: **[@mengpaper](https://x.com/mengpaper/status/2115416351238168833)** covers the preprint **"Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents…"**, in which AI agents rebuilt Blizzard's Hearthstone Battlegrounds as a simulator and used it to develop a bot that reached the server's top 100.

referenced_urls.title: Build, Don't Play: Self-Improving LLM Research Agents Develop...

relevance: Agents choosing to build tools (a simulator) rather than brute-force play is a vivid example of agentic problem-solving strategy.

media.description: Explainer video; preview frame reads 'AI-built bot vs. top players?' with a terminal-icon robot and leaderboard graphic.
